full_page.content:
1953, August 13
Brother, Father Edward.
Page 2
I shall try to reach them with a letter ahead of you. Barbara Bedolfe phoned, and Wallace himself wrote about his first confession and Holy Communion two weeks ago. Deo Gr! I believe it was on August 2nd.
Vigil August 14 -- - Blessed be God in her glorious Assumption!
Cremus Pro Invicem . Fr. Solanas, C.F.M. Cap.
Note : The above is a typewritten note by Fr. Solarus. Added in his own hand is, "Vigil ... invicem" pre- ceding signature. Also in his own hand added in the left margin is, "John & Conrad Green left Schwartzwald Baden. 1882 Green Bay".
